Answer: B
Reason: The ultrasound images show a fetal lung lesion composed of numerous small cysts (microcystic appearance) with no internal blood flow on color Doppler, which is characteristic of Congenital Cystic Adenomatoid Malformation (CCAM/CPAM) Type II. Type I lesions are typically large macrocysts (>2 cm), while Type III lesions appear solid/echogenic rather than distinctly cystic, and sequestrations usually demonstrate a systemic feeding vessel.
